original: 今日は雲行きが怪しいです。お花見が中止にならないか心配です。

en.text: I don't like the look of the weather today. I'm worried the hanami party might be cancelled.
It looks like it may rain today. I'm worried that our cherry-blossom-viewing party might be canceled.
